sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – securing 23,400 units per year
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation for the 24 mm mechanical seal (part:340010). We understand the capacity situation you described in your email of 18 September (doc:20260918-70410-P10), and that you are prioritising customers with firm, long-term commitments.

We would like to be one of those customers. We are open to a firm long-term commitment and can offer some flexibility on delivery scheduling.

Could you tell us which combination of contract duration and lead time would allow you to reserve 23,400 units per year for us? If it would help your planning, we would welcome a proposed delivery schedule.

We look forward to working out a package that suits both sides.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – securing 23,400 units per year
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €32.20 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 19890 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months. 

To secure an allocation of 23,400 units per year, we require a 36-month contract and a lead time of 56 days. This provides the necessary planning stability for our production schedule. Under these terms, the unit price remains at €32.20. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year and a contract term of 36 months: €32.20 per unit. 

Our Lieferzeit is 54 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – full allocation on your 36-month / 56-day structure
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for setting out what full allocation requires. We can accept both of your conditions: a 36-month contract and a 56-day lead time for 23,400 units per year.

In return, we ask that the price stay at its current level. Our orders for this seal on 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-21 were both at EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). We cite these as recent history, not as a binding entitlement.

We therefore propose EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400 units/year, 36 months and a 56-day lead time. Payment would be 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, with no index clause and no tooling.

This gives you the long-term planning stability you asked for, and gives us secure supply at a stable price. We would welcome your view.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – full allocation on your 36-month / 56-day structure
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Historical purchase orders do not govern current pricing under constrained capacity. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We note your agreement to the 36-month term and 56-day lead time for an allocation of 23,400 units per year. For this package, we offer a revised unit price of EUR 31.90. 

To summarize our Angebot: a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
